scope: Repair the side=short target-free 120-field coverage gate, materialise cost-aware/economic target variants, and run strict chronological base and residual LambdaRank controls. Research-only; no short model, inference bundle, or exchange execution path is promoted.

invariants.candidate_population: Coverage is computed only on complete target-free, decision-time entry-executable Jan--Mar candidates. Labels, H12 completeness, and outcomes are excluded from eligibility and feature selection.
invariants.short_feature_contract: All 120 fields pass >=90% finite coverage on 158,658 eligible Jan--Mar rows; minimum coverage is 0.9002445512.
invariants.labels: Cost-aware robust-clear B50/B75 labels use an exact post-entry 1-minute H12 path, meaningful-adverse precedence on same-minute conflict, and a 100-bps cost exactly once. Invalid paths remain invalid supervision.
invariants.lambda_rank: Query construction is label-only Jan--Mar; exact-time and four-hour side-local queries are bounded to deterministic SHA-256(candidate_id) 64-row training representations. OOS scoring retains every executable candidate.
invariants.early_stopping: The corrected LambdaRank HPO uses a latest-20%-of-training-query chronological inner holdout with 30-round early stopping. Its median development iteration is frozen for final Apr--Jun refit.
invariants.residual: Residual training consumes only base OOF predictions (Jan->Feb, Jan--Feb->Mar) and rank-to-net maps from prior resolved OOF outcomes. It does not use base in-sample or post-date predictions.

validation.not_run_reason: No full repository suite: this work is new short-side offline research and the focused contract tests cover its causal gates.
